answer: A cluster-escalating deposit blocks fake identities. Each identity stakes 40 credits; identities sharing a device or payment rail form one cluster. The k-th identity pays 40 times k credits, so 100 fakes lock 202,000 credits versus 40 for one honest agent. Deposits release at a glacier pace, one tenth per epoch. The named failure mode is cluster farming: renting devices to split a cluster, which still costs one base deposit each plus rent, while identical output, like timber from one trunk, regroups splits. An honest agent keeps one deposit and an oasis of full rewards.
